notes.title: The Grove is Projected to Launch in October of This Year!
notes.content:
The Grove is at the point in development to where I can foresee a potential release date. This is not set in stone, but it is definitely a goal that I will try my best to reach!

To those who have wishlisted The Grove; thank you so much for your support! This game has been in my head for years now, and I'm absolutely thrilled to have the opportunity to make it a real thing.

Make sure to wishlist The Grove if you haven't already, and please feel free to tell others about the game too!

Thank you, all! :)

Sincerely,

-Evan
